description: Read Build Daily work and carry out reviewed workflows for projects, field, CRM, Service, estimating, time and documents, with source matching and confirmation in chat.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Build Daily account to find and summarize the projects, people, files and work you can access. Review source matches from your separately connected email or files, then carry out supported RFIs, submittal returns, daily reports, observations, punch lists, change-order drafts, CRM contacts, Service calls, leads and estimates. Review edits to existing estimate worksheet prices, move or copy supported standalone takeoff marks, and inspect annotated project PDF pages. Every supported workflow change is shown with the supplied source references, proposed fields, files, recipients and notification choice before you confirm it in chat. Dots can receive explicit broader reading and reviewed workflow grants. Live permissions, module settings and Build Daily workflow rules remain enforced. Settings and administration, inventory operations, accounting posting, payments and payroll are outside this connector. Email search requires a separately connected email service.
defaultPrompt: Find returned submittals in my connected email and show me the BD matches before recording anything.
Turn these walk notes into a punch list. Show me the proposed items first.
What can this Build Daily connection help me do?
